summary.en: Jellyfin 10.10 media details and artwork now load correctly with API key authentication
summary.zh-CN: 修复 Jellyfin 10.10 使用 API Key 时媒体详情与图片无法加载的问题

text.en: Jellyfin media enrichment now uses the API-key-compatible item collection endpoint without requiring a user context, preventing HTTP 400 responses on Jellyfin 10.10.
text.zh-CN: Jellyfin 媒体补全改用兼容 API Key 且无需用户上下文的媒体集合接口，避免 Jellyfin 10.10 返回 HTTP 400。

text.en: Primary artwork is now requested even when the item response omits ImageTags, while missing artwork continues to fall back cleanly to a text-only display.
text.zh-CN: 即使媒体响应未包含 ImageTags 也会尝试获取主图；图片不存在时仍会正常回退为纯文本展示。

en: Deploy the immutable beta-v0.10.2 image and restart the container.
No database migration or configuration change is required.
zh-CN: 部署不可变镜像 beta-v0.10.2 并重启容器。
本次无需数据库迁移或配置变更。
